findings.claim: The gate authorization path for GET /api/cases/{case}/administering-entity authorizes by reading an existing resolution instead of authorizing the case target, so unresolved but readable cases are refused by the gate before the route can handle them.
findings.evidence: In the PolicyTarget::Resolution read branch, the diff calls `state.services.read_administering_entity(&context, &capabilities, case_id).await.map_err(resolution_policy_error)?;`; acceptance/task evidence for 1.4 requires the gate callback to recognize all three routes and `checks case:read or resolve_administering_entity and authorizes the case target before forwarding`, not require a resolution row to already exist.
findings.suggested_fix: For `PolicyTarget::Resolution { write: false }`, authorize the underlying case target with `read_case` or a dedicated read-target authorization method instead of `read_administering_entity`; leave the route handler responsible for returning unresolved/not-found resolution state.
